assets.prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve.
Create one new photograph of the exact fictional adult man in the reference. Preserve his particular face and quiet intensity.

CAMERA CHANGE — IMPORTANT:
Keep the man looking steadily at a person directly in front of him, at his own eye height. Move the CAMERA approximately 45 degrees around to the man's left, keeping the lens at eye height. This produces a definite three-quarter view of his face pointing toward the viewer's right. The subject continues to look straight ahead in his own space, not toward the relocated camera. Both eyes are visible, the far eye and far cheek distinctly narrower. Show real perspective depth through the nose and cheek, not a near-frontal head with sideways-moving eyes.

POSTURE AND PERFORMANCE:
His head is upright over the neck, chin level, shoulders open and settled, chest naturally supported. There is no forward head droop, coy tilt or raised gaze.
His eyes are clearly awake and precisely focused on the person ahead. Pupils are vertically centered in the visible eye opening. A small amount of tension in the LOWER eyelids conveys concentrated attention; the upper lids stay in their normal resting position, neither raised wide nor lowered sleepily. Brows retain the reference's shape and natural position. Forehead quiet.
Lips meet lightly with subtle muscular control, without pursing, smiling or tightening into a scowl. He is actively assessing the person in front of him, withholding his conclusion. Let the other person fill the silence. The face conveys self-possession and reserved authority, with inward emotional tension, not fatigue, wistfulness, reassurance-seeking or innocent receptiveness.

IDENTITY:
Preserve the reference's facial width and length, cheekbones, eye spacing, nose shape, mouth width, adult jaw definition and understated continuous chin. Keep the lower face substantial and naturally angular, without a pointed chin, central chin cleft or separate block-like chin pad. Same youthful adult age, gray-dominant pale gray-blue irises, short dark wavy hair, black shirt and dark textured jacket.

LIGHTING:
Moderate directional window light with broad coherent cheek and eye-socket shadows and restrained fill. Normal facial exposure, readable skin and both eyes; do not create the mood by simply darkening the whole portrait. Natural skin texture. Same subdued architectural interior. Vertical 3:4 portrait showing head, neck and upper chest with enough shoulders to read the stable posture. No text, extra objects or collage.
